campaign_order_algorithm: 20 balanced shape rounds; rotate layout order by round; each shape appears once in every layout and has three specs per commanded direction; stages retain cumulative counts 12/48/84/120.

resume_ledger_contract.immutability: CREATE/APPEND only; record_sha256 hashes the canonical row without record_sha256; previous_record_sha256 forms a chain; old rows may never be edited or deleted.

resume_semantics.attempt_number: one plus highest prior attempt for the exact spec
resume_semantics.continue: earliest campaign-order spec without ACCEPTED, unless it has three rejected attempts, which is BLOCKED
resume_semantics.skip: all specs with a valid ACCEPTED ATTEMPT_CLASSIFIED record

resume_ledger_contract.storage_format: append-only JSONL, one canonical JSON object per line, fsync after append

stage_a_semantics: First two balanced shape rounds: exactly two specs/layout, opposite commanded directions within layout, and two distinct shape classes.
